dataList.content:
Long time no see, strangers. Word is you've been having all kinds of fun without me around; is that right? I would've come running ages ago to join in, but... ugh. You wouldn't believe how much work I've had piled on me.
好久不见，异乡人。听说我不在的时候你们都玩得很开心啊。我本来是想赶来凑热闹的……哎哟，可惜要办的事儿实在是太多了。

<She really can turn up anywhere...>
<她真的……可以出现在任何地方啊。>

... Since you've already dropped in, answer me one thing. What exactly does it mean to be "lacking in virtue"?
……你来都来了，我们就顺便问你个问题吧。你刚刚说的“美德不够”……是什么意思？

What a tedious question. Nearly as tedious as that antiquated arm you've got there.
真是个无聊的问题。简直就像你那条老掉牙的手臂一样无聊。

Just answer the question, will you?
你还是回答问题吧，行不行……？

Hmm, fine. You won't get a different ending anyway, so I suppose I can tell you that much. Besides... I'm sure it'll come to that runt soon enough, when its instincts kick in.
哼，好吧，反正结局也不会改变的，告诉你们也无妨。反正……那边那个小不点很快就会本能地想起那些事。

<... Won't get a different ending...?>
<……结局不会发生变化是什么意思……>

To lack virtue means to lack nobility. Which is to say... become noble, become prestigious, and you'll be granted entry into this place. Do you get what I'm saying? 美德不足，意味着不够高贵。总而言之……只要变得更高贵，就能进入这里了。听明白了吗？

I comprehend it not in the slightest... Ah. Could this, perchance, be... a matter of fashion?
我依旧毫无头绪……啊。难道说……是时尚的问题吗？
I would have been terribly disappointed if you still hadn't grasped what it means to "become nobler" in here. 如果你们还没搞懂在百货店里变得更加高贵是什么意思的话，我一定会大失所望的。

In any case, bingo again. Nobility demands consumption befitting one's station—and garments befitting it as well. And the one thing in this store certain to raise that station is...
没错。要想变得高贵，就需要进行足够多的消费，并穿上够格的服装。而在这家百货店里，能用来提高自身地位的东西显然就是……

A garment fashioned from the material known as Golden Hide... or Golden Resin.
由黄金皮革……或是黄金松脂等材料制成的服装。

The next time we meet... do try to return with the outcome I desire, hmm?
下次见面的时候……希望你们能够带来我想要的结果。

As fun as it is to watch you idiots fumble around in the dark, I'd much prefer it if you got on with the "melting this stupid Grand Magasin to the ground" part.
看着你们如白痴般笨拙的样子是挺有趣的……但这样下去可就真的永远都无法瓦解这该死的百货店了。

Be seeing you~
再见~

... She's gone.
……她不见了。

<She helped us again, but I still can't tell what she's really after.>
<……她又帮了我们一次，但我依旧猜不透她的心思。>
that much, did she? Does she just show up randomly to unnerve us or something...?> <吱咿迟早会自己想起来……听起来不太妙，她纯粹就是来搞我们心态的吧……>

... As before, she appears disinclined to provide us with information of genuine utility. Perhaps her purpose lies nearer to mockery than aid.
……她以前也没带来什么好消息。倒不如说，她更像是来嘲笑我们的。

Hey... Do you think she went ahead inside? Looks like there are people in there...
那啥……她是不是到那里面去了？我看那里面好像有些人……

... If "nobility" is prerequisite to entry... then mayhaps those within are themselves persons of noble standing.
……要想进入其中就要变得高贵……那里面的人们或许亦是高贵之人。

Those people...
那些人们……

It looks like all they can do is... sit where they're told and eat what they're given...
除了坐在指定的位子上，吃着指定的料理以外……好像什么都做不了。

Hm... The order of ceremony, too, seems predetermined. A repast of pomp and circumstance... I believe it is called "dining of fine nature."
嗯……顺序似乎也是定好的。井然有序的晚宴……这应该就叫“雅宴”吧。

Why are they waiting for the next course instead of eating everything all at once? Aren't they wasting eating time?
他们为什么要等顺序？等待的话……不就吃不了多少东西了吗？

Why do they sit in assigned seats and eat assigned food in assigned amounts?
他们为什么要坐在指定的位子上，吃着指定的食物，按着指定好的进餐量吃东西？

I don't get it. Why don't they just eat and eat? Why don't they just clean a dish and move on to the next one until there's nothing left?
我不明白。全都吃光不就好了吗？由近至远，一干二净。

Well... different "classes," different cultures, right?
嘛……在不同的世界里，可能也会有不同的文化嘛，对不对？

For a long while, Pwie silently watched the banquet beyond the curtain,
吱咿一言不发地盯着帷幕另一端的晚宴。

like a starving child salivating at a lavish feast past the display glass.
就像是饥饿的孩子盯着橱窗里的美食。

I'm... I'm so hungry. And I want... to wear it.
我……还是好饿。另外……我想穿一件衣服。

A Golden Shroud... made of Golden Hide, flayed off the walls...
一件用剥下来的黄金皮革做出来的……金色寿衣……

<Did that thought just come to you?>
<你是突然想到这个的吗？>

Did the thought occur to you without prior deliberation?
你是突然想到这件事了吗？

Mhm. Just came to me.
嗯，我想到了。

A shroud, you say? A shroud is... a garment reserved for one embarking upon their final journey. And you wish to wear such...?
你是说寿衣吗？那不是……只能给踏上最终路途的人穿的衣服吗……？

Mhm. The last attire that will ever be put on my body.
嗯，将被穿在我身上的最后一件衣服。

Because I'm going to... grow up.
因为……我将成长。

And to grow up, I'll need clothes made to fit what I'll become.
所以我需要穿上与之相衬的服装。

<If it's made of Golden Hide that's been peeled off... then the production process must be different from making Golden Fabric.>
<剥取黄金皮革制作的服装……应该要采用跟黄金面料不一样的工艺吧。>

If the handbag designer's statement was accurate... there should be an employee underground capable of processing hides.
如果箱包馆设计师的情报属实……地下应该会有能够加工皮革的人。

<That's B3F, right...? We'll probably have to locate its escalator first, just like we did for the fifth floor.>
<B3F……看来我们得先像来5F的时候那样，找找扶梯了。>

<All right, let's head down and have Pwie's clothes made.>
<走吧，去下面为吱咿做衣服吧。>

... We will make an article of clothing that fits you.
……我们会为你制作合身的服装。

... Why?
……为什么？

Because that is what you want, and in turn, our desire as well.
因为那既是你的愿望，也是我们的愿望。

... Thanks.
……谢谢。

Hey, Manager Bud. What are you doin' there staring into space?
经理兄，你傻站着干嘛？

<No, it's just... hearing Pwie thank us...>
<没什么……我只是听着吱咿道谢……>

<It reminded me of the first time all of you listened to me. Really listened.>
<想起了以前你们第一次听我的话的时候……>

... And for all that has transpired before that moment, and what came thereafter... I remain ever grateful.
……对于那些事……我一直都心怀感激……
